description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useVerifyUsersUrlOnce' that performs a one-time development-only verification of the URL resolution for '/api/users' endpoint. It logs the resolved URL and potential errors during development, but performs no network calls in production.

methods.name: useVerifyUsersUrlOnce()
methods.description: React hook that logs a verification message once when the component mounts, applicable only in development mode.
